data.summary:
A results-driven Principal Data Scientist with 6+ years of experience architecting and deploying high-impact AI/ML, Generative AI, Time Series Forecasting, Deep Learning, Data Engineering, and Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) solutions across the Automotive, Pharmaceutical, and BFSI sectors. Managed the end-to-end project lifecycle & skilled in sophisticated RAG architecture, LLM fine-tuning, and multi-agent AI systems deployment to solve complex business problems. I have a proven track record of delivering significant value, from enhancing customer support with multimodal AI agents at Toyota to optimizing multi-million-dollar inventories at Sun Pharma & process Optimization at Dr. Reddy’s and Jubilant. I am passionate about building scalable, enterprise-grade AI systems and ensuring their ethical deployment by adhering to Responsible AI standards.
KEY AI/ML SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES
Generative AI: RAG, Fine-tuning, LLMs, LangChain, Llama-Index, Vector DBs, Prompt Engineering, Diffusion
AI Agents: AutoGen, LangGraph, CrewAI, Multi-Agent Systems, Tool Integration, Multimodal Models
Deep Learning: NLP, Computer
Machine Learning: XGBoost,
Vision, TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX, ISO/IEC 42001 Principles, TimeGPT, Transformers, TimesFM
LightGBM, Random Forest, SVM, Prophet, ARIMA, Gurobi, SciPy, Scikit- learn, Clustering, Anomaly Detection
Cloud & BI Tools: AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, EC2, S3, Redshift), Azure (AI, Databricks), GCP (Vertex AI, Big Query), PowerBI, Tableau, QlikView
Data Engineering & MLOps: Python, R, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Docker, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), FastAPI, Weights & Biases (WandB), SQL, PostgreSQL (PostGIS), ETL, JIRA
